instances.claim: This tells me that Rutherford Chang chose the penny because Brenner's Lincoln is the most reproduced artwork on Earth.
instances.why: Line 2 holds the decision expression ('chose', attributed to Rutherford Chang) and line 1, immediately before it, states a property of the object (most reproduced artwork on Earth) that reads as the reason; neither line alone asserts a motive, but the property-then-decision order supplies one. The draft states no reason, motive or origin for Chang's choice anywhere — lines 3-7 characterize the work's tone and the object's persistence, not why he selected it — so nothing competes with the invented reason.
